api_contracts.purpose: Return stable package identity for smoke acceptance.
Produce a bounded evidence pack from one grounding request.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid requests raise before provider access; provider failures return PROVIDER_ERROR evidence status.

api_contracts.purpose: Return untrusted source candidates for exactly one budgeted provider call.
api_contracts.mutation: provider-defined external behavior; Phase 2 ships SearxngProvider
api_contracts.error_behavior: Provider exceptions are contained by GroundingEngine and fail closed.

api_contracts.purpose: Perform one already-budgeted live JSON search against the configured SearXNG endpoint.
api_contracts.mutation: network GET to operator-configured SearXNG only; no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Transport, redirect, HTTP, content type, response-size, JSON, or result-schema failures raise SearchProviderError.

api_contracts.purpose: Read one bounded application/json response without redirect following.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Fails closed with SearchProviderError on invalid or oversized response.

api_contracts.purpose: Fetch and extract one untrusted result page through a validated public-IP-pinned connection.
api_contracts.mutation: network read only; returns immutable FetchedDocument
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid URL/port/DNS target, transport/TLS failure, redirect/non-200 response, disallowed content metadata, overflow, or decode failure raises FetchError without returning partial content.

api_contracts.purpose: Resolve one result-page host and return deduplicated public addresses only when every DNS answer is public.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Resolution failure, empty answers, malformed addresses, or any non-public/multicast answer raises FetchError.

api_contracts.purpose: Chunk bounded fetched documents and return deterministic positive-score BM25 lexical hits.
api_contracts.mutation: in-memory derivation only; no persistent mutation
api_contracts.error_behavior: Empty/oversized query or out-of-policy document/chunk/result bounds raise RetrievalError before returning hits.

api_contracts.purpose: Split one immutable FetchedDocument into bounded overlapping TextChunk values with stable provenance.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid chunk size, overlap, or per-document chunk cap raises RetrievalError.

api_contracts.purpose: Rank in-memory chunks with BM25 and return only positive lexical matches in deterministic order.
api_contracts.error_behavior: Invalid query or result limit raises RetrievalError; no matches returns an empty tuple.

data_contracts.name: GroundingRequest
invariants: max_search_rounds is validated to 1..2
results_per_call is validated to 1..10
min_evidence_sources is at least 1

data_contracts.name: EvidencePack
invariants: GROUNDED requires minimum unique evidence sources
provider error before sufficiency is PROVIDER_ERROR
budget exhaustion without sufficiency is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

data_contracts.name: Canonical source URL
invariants: only http and https are accepted
credentials are rejected
fragments do not distinguish sources
duplicate canonical URLs count once

data_contracts.name: Admissible search-result URL
invariants: scheme is http or https
userinfo credentials are forbidden
localhost names are forbidden
ASCII control characters are forbidden
literal IP targets must be globally routable and non-multicast
named hosts are resolved again at fetch time and every answer must be globally routable and non-multicast

data_contracts.name: FetchedDocument
invariants: url has no fragment and uses standard-port HTTP(S)
fetched_from_ip is a validated public IP selected from the fetch-time DNS answer set
media_type and charset passed the explicit allowlist
byte_length is bounded before text extraction
text is untrusted evidence data and not an instruction authority

data_contracts.name: TextChunk
data_contracts.retention: retrieval-call lifetime unless caller retains it
invariants: chunk_id is deterministic for the same source URL, chunk index, and text
source_url preserves FetchedDocument provenance
chunk_index follows deterministic source order
text is bounded by the configured and hard-capped chunk word limit
token_count is derived deterministically from lexical tokenization

data_contracts.name: LexicalHit
data_contracts.retention: retrieval-call lifetime unless caller retains it
invariants: score is positive
rank starts at 1 and follows deterministic BM25 ordering
ties resolve by stable source provenance and chunk identity
hit count never exceeds the configured hard-capped limit
